# LinkedIn Post Writer - Posts in Your Voice, Approved Before Publishing

Curated by Skill Harbor: the Post Writer skill from the sergebulaev linkedin-skills bundle (SKILL.md, 129 lines total at the pinned commit, MIT). It drafts long-form LinkedIn posts from 20 hook formulas, picked by engagement goal first (comments, reposts, likes, or saves) then by topic, with a voice-profile step, a story-bank step that never invents a figure that is not in the bank, a humanizer pass, and an approval card (formula used, full draft, character count, suggested posting window) before anything is published. DRAFT LEG ONLY: this fiche drafts for approval and copy-paste into LinkedIn; the publishing leg was deliberately not run. This skill is NOT a single self-contained folder: its SKILL.md points at shared files, so the install must carry the skill folder PLUS the repo references/ and lib/ trees, and skills/linkedin-humanizer/ for illustrations, keeping the relative layout, or the formula skeletons will be missing and the illustration step will be unavailable. A LinkedIn account is needed to post as yourself; no key is needed for drafting. Direct publishing needs Publora (optional) and reading other people's posts needs Apify or pasted text (optional); those prices and free tiers are publisher claims, unverified here. An approved post is not always reversible: approval can mean publication via Publora, cancellable only before it goes out, via the Publora dashboard. Nothing is posted without approval on the exact draft.
